name: grok
specialty: Different model family: builds, reviews, and gives independent second opinions that catch blind spots.
notes: In headless `grok -p`, tools that need approval are auto-denied; the run ends with "permission required: ... was not run, as a headless run cannot ask for approval". Grant what a seat needs with --permission-mode and --allow up front.
acceptEdits alone still blocked Edit in headless mode; builders also need --allow Edit --allow Write.
Builders get no shell (--deny Bash): the lead runs tests and commits.
Status: grok version. Models: grok models (grok-4.7, grok-4.7-build-fast, grok-4.6, grok-4.5).
